items.text: That swing missed by a whole dock's width.

items.text: The crowd felt that one in its rented seats.

items.text: A sharp turn, a faster answer, and absolutely no apology.

items.text: The guard held, but the confidence took a hit.

items.text: A risky step forward, and it paid off in a big way.

items.text: The tide may be out, but the pressure is coming in.

items.text: A tiny opening, spotted and taken. That's veteran work.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: I brought a whistle. Is it for me or the fighters?

items.text: The snack stand says the kelp fries are delayed again.

items.text: That sponsor board has better seats than I do.

items.text: I thought 'sudden death' was a menu item.

items.text: Do they sell foam claws at the door? Asking for a friend.

items.text: I am keeping score in seashells. It is going poorly.

items.text: Somebody in the crowd is wearing the same hat as me.

items.text: Is the bookie allowed to bet on the ref's shoes?

items.text: Kendall, was that a strategy or a lucky bounce?

items.text: Between rounds, any expert analysis?

items.text: The crowd is getting louder!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: I think they saw a gull steal someone's lunch.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: What does the tide say about this fight?

items.text: It says I should have worn taller boots.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: You have a prediction for the next exchange?

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Someone will swing. I'm almost certain.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Can you name that maneuver?

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: The flailing one? I know that one.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Our officials are watching closely.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: One of them has a very nice mustache.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Is that the Cannery whistle again?

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: No, that was me. I found the whistle.

items.text: The bookie's making a face at that result.

items.text: Maybe he just saw the bill for the lights.

items.text: What's your read on the arena tonight?

items.text: Hard floor. Loud fans. Excellent ceiling.

items.text: A sharp answer to that opening; both corners saw the lesson land.

items.text: The first fighter steps in; the second one edits the plan in real time.

items.text: That shot changed the rhythm, and the whole cage heard the new beat.

items.text: They traded space, traded shots, and neither one gave the aisle an inch.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: That was a brave step forward, and a clever step back right after it.

items.text: The timing was perfect; the expression afterward was mostly surprise.

items.text: A quick touch to start, then a full argument about who owns the center.

items.text: That landed right on the beat, and the crowd supplied the drum roll.

items.text: Both fighters found the range at once; neither found a quiet way out.

items.text: The pace just climbed a gear, and somebody left the old gear on the floor.

items.text: The opening appeared for half a second; one fighter used all of it.

items.text: They met in the middle and immediately disputed the floor plan.

items.text: That was a clean answer, delivered before the question had finished.

items.text: The pressure is steady now; the corners are running out of calm advice.

items.text: That hit carried across the arena like news nobody wanted to miss.

items.text: The rhythm broke, the feet reset, and the contest found a fresh chapter.

items.text: One step drew the guard; the next step took the space underneath it.

items.text: That exchange had no wasted motion and one very useful surprise.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The center changed hands again; somebody should start keeping a ledger.

items.text: They both committed, both connected, and both look ready to argue about it.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The corner asked for patience; the fighter answered with excellent timing.

items.text: A quick burst of offense, then a graceful exit from a crowded conversation.

items.text: I blinked at the wrong time. Was that one hit or a whole short story?

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: That sounded important. I am writing it down as 'very important.'

items.text: The crowd made a noise like a kettle discovering the final round.

items.text: I counted three steps, then the action moved somewhere else entirely.

items.text: That looked clean from here, though my view is mostly a tall hat.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: I think the center belongs to whoever brought the better shoes.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: The pace is picking up. I should probably put my snack down.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Did anyone see where the last plan went? It left in a hurry.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: I would call that a bold choice, if I knew which choice it was.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: The arena has a new rhythm, and I am tapping the wrong foot.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: I heard a thump, saw a turn, and lost my place in the program.

items.text: That exchange had excellent timing and deeply confusing footnotes.

items.text: The corners are calm; the fighters have not received that memo.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: I am sure the bookie can explain that sequence. He owes me a diagram.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: The front row leaned back together. That is a very strong review.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: I think the cage just moved. Devon says it was only the camera.

items.text: That was quick enough to make my notes arrive after the action.

items.text: I had a prediction, but the fight changed it while I was speaking.

items.text: This is why I bring a pencil. The score is moving faster than I am.

items.text: The crowd is cheering; I am cheering too, just a half-beat late.

items.text: The guard came up just in time; the follow-up found only air and regret.

items.text: That sidestep let the whole attack pass like a ferry on the wrong route.

items.text: A well-read feint, a patient guard, and a counter waiting at the door.

items.text: The pressure was real, but the defender found a pocket of space.

items.text: That parry sent the plan aside and left a fresh opening in its place.

items.text: The first swing missed; the second met a very prepared defense.

items.text: A tidy escape from a messy hold, and a quick reset before the next rush.

items.text: The guard absorbed the shock; the fighter kept the answer for later.

items.text: That dodge was so neat the front row checked for a trap door.

items.text: A smart retreat, a sharper pivot, and the center is back up for grabs.

items.text: The pressure keeps coming; the defense keeps giving it somewhere to go.

items.text: One shoulder turn took the sting off that shot and changed the angle.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The counter was waiting in the exact place the first attack had left open.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: A grip breaks, a step lands, and the fighter is free to make new trouble.

items.text: The attack found a wall of guard, then a counter with very clear directions.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: A small retreat bought just enough room for a much bigger answer.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The timing on that block was excellent; the follow-through was even better.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The fighter read the shoulder, moved early, and made the swing look slow.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: A quick slip under the attack; now the pursuer has to turn around.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: That was a patient defense, followed by an impatiently good counter.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The hands stayed home until the opening arrived; then they did not wait.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: A parry at the last moment sends the threat off course and the crowd up.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: They tried to hold the line; one sharp turn found the open gate.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The rush came fast, but the defender had already booked the side exit.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: A clean break from the clinch and a calm breath before the next exchange.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: That guard survived the storm; now the fighter gets to choose the weather.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: A feint was spotted, the bait was ignored, and the real attack was met.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The feet gave ground without giving up; that is veteran ring craft.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The attack found no target, and the counter found a very clear one.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Was that a dodge or a sudden appointment somewhere else in the cage?

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: The guard looked sturdy. I would like one for the booth, please.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: That fighter moved aside so politely the punch nearly said excuse me.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: The grab is gone, the plan is gone, and I have misplaced my pen again.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: The defense said no, the counter said maybe, and the crowd said louder.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: I saw a shoulder twitch and called it a weather warning. Was I close?

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: The escape was so quick I thought somebody opened a side door.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: The fighter made room with their feet; I make room by moving my chair.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: I could use that guard against my lunch. It keeps falling off the plate.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: I am told that was a parry. I thought it was a very firm handshake.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: The attacker had a plan, but the defender appears to have read the envelope.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: That pivot was smooth. My chair makes the same noise when I try it.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Somebody caught the wrist, changed the angle, and rescued the whole exchange.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: The corner is celebrating the block; I am celebrating finding the scoreboard.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: The fighter slipped left, the camera slipped right, and I am still centered.

items.text: A throw ends on the floor, and the recovery starts before the dust settles.

items.text: I was ready to count, but the fighter stood before I found the number.

items.text: The floor won that round of the conversation. The fighter wants a rematch.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Somebody check the canvas; it seems to be collecting frequent visitors.

items.text: That was a quick rise. I am still sitting down from the last one.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: I dropped my pencil at the count. It is not a sanctioned strategy.

items.text: I think the count got nervous and stopped before it could finish.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: The crowd stood up; I stood up too, then forgot why I was standing.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: The mat has a busy evening. It may ask for a second towel soon.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Recovery looks simple when they do it. I need a chair and a map.

items.text: That fighter got up with a look that says the floor can keep the receipt.

items.text: If the steam vent has a name, I would like to put it on the card.

items.text: The spring pad launched someone; my notes have not landed yet.

items.text: That hazard moved the fight. Could it also move my booth closer?

items.text: The last shift never clocked out: KNELL, the Hollow Diver!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: That salvage suit came back from the deep with a bell to ring: KNELL!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: There's a lantern in the fog and a fighter at the bell. KNELL walks in.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Knell's hollow suit is quiet; those hooks have plenty to say.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Ghost Light is away, homing through the cage toward its mark.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Knell sent Ghost Light after the target. That lantern does not lose the trail.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Through the Veil! Knell blinks out and strikes on the other side.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Knell's phase step evades the rush, then rings out around the landing.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Last Bell! Knell is ringing the whole cage with expanding bursts.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Knell's Last Bell is live. Stay alert for the next ring and the next one.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Three rings are rolling outward. Knell has made the floor part of the fight.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Last Bell is building: each pulse reaches farther across the cage.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The lantern is following its mark; Knell is planning around the path.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: That Sounding Jab found range. Knell has a clear line to close.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Port Hook! Knell is measuring distance one heavy pull at a time.
items.retired: wrong: Port Hook is a light hook, not a pull

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Deadweight lands with a thud; the opponent needs to shift their footing.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Knell's Anchor Fist is loading. That's a lot of harbor behind one punch.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Deep Anchor is loaded. The next hit could send someone sailing.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Knell's Wake Breaker closes distance before the counter can settle.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The Rising Bell turns the finish upward. Watch the landing.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Through the Veil makes a bad position temporary. The reappearance is the danger.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Ghost Light homes in; running in a straight line is a risky plan.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Knell's kit is patient: mark the target, change position, then ring them.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The bell is part of the fight now. Knell has made the whole cage listen.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Knell's Salvage Grip has both hands on the problem.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Nobody Home is the taunt. That empty helmet is still intimidating.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: That anchor hit carries weight. Knell is not in a hurry to throw it twice.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The lantern holds attention while Knell takes a different angle.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: I thought the lantern went out. It was just following someone else.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: That bell has a longer shift than I do.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Is the Hollow Diver taking questions? I have one about the lantern.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Knell's entrance made my pencil stop writing.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: The bell rang. I am not sure the cage was asked first.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: That blink is useful; I blinked and lost my notes.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Scrap can leave fighters Rattled for four seconds: guard costs more, poise returns slower.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Rattled raises guard's stamina cost by a quarter and slows poise recovery.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: That Scrap hit left them Rattled; holding guard is suddenly more expensive.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The Scrap status is Rattled; it burdens guard and slows poise recovery.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Scrap hits build Rattled, a four-second check on guard and poise.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Scrap hits hardest into Grit: that matchup adds fifteen percent damage.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Rattled lasts four seconds, so a patient defender can wait it out.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Scrap is resisted by Spectral, but gets the edge against Grit.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Rattled makes guard cost more. My guard is mostly a notebook.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Four seconds of Rattled sounds long. I lose my place in two.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Haunted lasts five seconds: cooldowns take 75% time; received healing is 80%.
items.retired: wrong: Haunted slows cooldowns; corrected take recorded

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Haunted shortens cooldowns by a quarter and cuts received healing by twenty percent.
items.retired: wrong: Haunted slows cooldowns; corrected take recorded

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Spectral builds Haunted. That status changes cooldowns and makes healing less effective.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Haunted lasts five seconds, so that healing penalty has a clear window.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Spectral carries a fifteen percent edge over Scrap in the matchup chart.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Static is favored against Spectral; the type chart can turn a fight.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Knell's Spectral hits can leave the other corner Haunted.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The Haunted status weakens incoming healing while its cooldown effect runs.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Haunted helps cooldowns move, but your healing takes a hit.
items.retired: wrong: Haunted slows cooldowns; corrected take recorded

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: I heard a bell and checked my cooldown. It was probably unrelated.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Against Dozer's forward push, Varga needs to angle off the center line.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Dozer comes straight ahead; Varga's route might need a little diagram.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Can Varga make Dredge turn before that chain finds its range?

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Dredge has reach; Varga has angles. I brought a protractor.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Jitters is quick; Varga's angle change will need exact timing.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Varga versus Jitters: the speed notes are already running off the page.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Against Slurry's movement, Varga will need to keep that lead hand busy.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Slurry is hard to pin down. Varga, I hope your notes are waterproof.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Dozer brings the forward pressure; Knell can blink before it lands.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Dozer charges, Knell vanishes. I would like that option at the booth.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Ghost Light against Jitters: a lantern trying to catch lightning.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Jitters is fast, but that lantern seems very committed.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Slurry is tricky to pin down; Knell's light can follow the mark.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Slurry versus the lantern: I am rooting for both from a safe distance.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Dredge brings chain range; Knell brings an anchor of its own.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Two salvage specialists, one cage, and I am keeping my pencil inside.
